accounts.name: state
docs: Velocity's `State`, read for the live slot duration so the oracle
staleness windows here match the ones velocity itself applies. The PDA
belongs to the velocity program, so the derivation names it explicitly.

fields.name: amm_fee_numerator
docs: Share of the trade-fee *remainder* (taker fee after maker rebate, referral,
referee discount, and filler reward are taken off the top) provisioned to
the AMM as liquidity (its backstop-of-last-resort tranche, tracked in
`PerpMarket.fee_ledger.amm_protocol_fees_received` alongside the vAMM
maker rebate when that feature is enabled). precision:
FEE_PERCENTAGE_DENOMINATOR. `amm_fee_numerator + if_fee_numerator` must
be <= FEE_PERCENTAGE_DENOMINATOR; the protocol receives the residual
(`remainder − amm − if`) into its withdrawable `protocol_fee_pool`.
(Was the reserved `padding: u64`, repartitioned into two u32s —
size/alignment unchanged.)

fields.name: if_fee_numerator
docs: Share of the trade-fee remainder routed to the insurance fund (`revenue_pool`).

fields.name: slot
docs: The slot the order was placed

fields.name: price
docs: The limit price for the order (can be 0 for market orders)
For orders with an auction, this price isn't used until the auction is complete
precision: PRICE_PRECISION

fields.name: base_asset_amount
docs: The size of the order
precision for perps: BASE_PRECISION
precision for spot: token mint precision

fields.name: base_asset_amount_filled
docs: The amount of the order filled
precision for perps: BASE_PRECISION
precision for spot: token mint precision

fields.name: quote_asset_amount_filled
docs: The amount of quote filled for the order
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: trigger_price
docs: At what price the order will be triggered. Only relevant for trigger orders
precision: PRICE_PRECISION

fields.name: auction_start_price
docs: The start price for the auction. Only relevant for market/oracle orders
precision: PRICE_PRECISION

fields.name: auction_end_price
docs: The end price for the auction. Only relevant for market/oracle orders
precision: PRICE_PRECISION

fields.name: max_ts
docs: The time when the order will expire

fields.name: oracle_price_offset
docs: If set, the order limit price is the oracle price + this offset
precision: PRICE_PRECISION

fields.name: order_id
docs: The id for the order. Each users has their own order id space

fields.name: market_index
docs: The perp/spot market index

fields.name: status
docs: Whether the order is open or unused

fields.name: order_type
docs: The type of order

fields.name: market_type
docs: Whether market is spot or perp

fields.name: user_order_id
docs: User generated order id. Can make it easier to place/cancel orders

fields.name: existing_position_direction
docs: What the users position was when the order was placed

fields.name: direction
docs: Whether the user is going long or short. LONG = bid, SHORT = ask

fields.name: reduce_only
docs: Whether the order is allowed to only reduce position size

fields.name: post_only
docs: Whether the order must be a maker

fields.name: immediate_or_cancel
docs: Whether the order must be canceled the same slot it is placed

fields.name: trigger_condition
docs: Whether the order is triggered above or below the trigger price. Only relevant for trigger orders

fields.name: auction_duration
docs: Auction length in wall clock 400ms units (one slot at the 400ms
baseline, where the raw value is identical to the historical slot
count). Progress compares `SlotClock::elapsed` against this value's
wall clock length, so the ramp holds at every slot duration and the
u8 keeps the full historical 72s range.

fields.name: posted_slot_tail
docs: Last 8 bits of the slot the order was posted onchain (not order slot for signed msg orders)

fields.name: bit_flags
docs: Bitflags for further classification
0: is_signed_message

types.name: OrderFillerRewardStructure
docs: `u128` is placed first so `#[repr(C)]` layout matches between host (x86_64,
align 16 in Rust ≥ 1.77) and the SBF VM (align 8). Trailing `_padding`
rounds the struct to a host-portable 32 bytes. See
`docs/alignment-and-native-offsets.md`.

fields.name: last_cumulative_funding_rate
docs: The perp market's last cumulative funding rate. Used to calculate the funding payment owed to user
precision: FUNDING_RATE_PRECISION

fields.name: base_asset_amount
docs: the size of the users perp position
precision: BASE_PRECISION

fields.name: quote_asset_amount
docs: Used to calculate the users pnl. Upon entry, is equal to base_asset_amount * avg entry price - fees
Updated when the user open/closes position or settles pnl. Includes fees/funding
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: quote_break_even_amount
docs: The amount of quote the user would need to exit their position at to break even
Updated when the user open/closes position or settles pnl. Includes fees/funding
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: quote_entry_amount
docs: The amount quote the user entered the position with. Equal to base asset amount * avg entry price
Updated when the user open/closes position. Excludes fees/funding
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: open_bids
docs: The amount of non reduce only trigger orders the user has open
precision: BASE_PRECISION

fields.name: open_asks
docs: The amount of non reduce only trigger orders the user has open
precision: BASE_PRECISION

fields.name: settled_pnl
docs: The amount of pnl settled in this market since opening the position
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: isolated_position_scaled_balance
docs: The scaled balance of the isolated position
precision: SPOT_BALANCE_PRECISION

fields.name: market_index
docs: The market index for the perp market

fields.name: open_orders
docs: The number of open orders

fields.name: scaled_balance
docs: The scaled balance of the position. To get the token amount, multiply by the cumulative deposit/borrow
interest of corresponding market.
precision: SPOT_BALANCE_PRECISION

fields.name: open_bids
docs: How many spot non reduce only trigger orders the user has open
precision: token mint precision

fields.name: open_asks
docs: How many spot non reduce only trigger orders the user has open
precision: token mint precision

fields.name: cumulative_deposits
docs: The cumulative deposits/borrows a user has made into a market
precision: token mint precision

fields.name: market_index
docs: The market index of the corresponding spot market

fields.name: balance_type
docs: Whether the position is deposit or borrow

fields.name: open_orders
docs: Number of open orders

fields.name: cold_admin
docs: Root authority. Set at `initialize`; only this key can rotate `warm_admin`
and `pause_admin`. Expected to sit behind a (small) timelocked multisig.

fields.name: warm_admin
docs: Operational authority (e.g. multisig+timelock). Can rotate the 10 hot keys
below. `Pubkey::default()` means unset — only `cold_admin` can act in that case.

fields.name: pause_admin
docs: Emergency pause authority. No onchain timelock — intended to live behind a
fast-acting multisig that can flip pause flags without delay. May only *add*
pause bits (never clear them); cold/warm retain full pause + unpause power.
`Pubkey::default()` means unassigned (only cold/warm can pause).

fields.name: hot_amm_crank
docs: Purpose-specific bot keys. `Pubkey::default()` means the role is unassigned
and only warm/cold can call handlers gated on that role.

fields.name: hot_vamm_quote_management
docs: Active-management authority for scoped vAMM quoting controls carried by
`HotAdminUpdatePerpMarket`, plus the low-CU native spread adjustment.
This may be a multisig PDA; timelock policy lives in that multisig.

fields.name: min_perp_auction_duration
docs: Compact wall-clock duration encoded in historical 400ms slot quanta.

fields.name: default_market_order_time_in_force
docs: Default time-in-force for market orders, in seconds. `Order.max_ts` is a
unix timestamp, so this never converts through the slot length and stays
a raw integer. It currently has no onchain reader.

fields.name: default_spot_auction_duration
docs: An actual slot-count setting, not a wall-clock duration. It currently has
no onchain reader (spot DLOB trading is disabled), so it intentionally
remains raw rather than using `StoredSlotDuration`.

fields.name: liquidation_duration
docs: Compact wall-clock duration encoded in historical 400ms slot quanta.

fields.name: solvency_status
docs: Bitmask of `SolvencyStatus` flags. Gates internal solvency-repair flows
(bankruptcy / pnl-deficit resolution) independently of `WithdrawPaused`,
so user withdrawals can be halted while repair keeps running, or repair
can be frozen on its own when an oracle is suspect. `0` = repair allowed.

fields.name: protocol_fee_recipient_perp
docs: Treasury that PERP protocol fees (quote-denominated) may be withdrawn
to. Settable only by `cold_admin`. `withdraw_protocol_fees_perp` pays
this key's associated token account (recipient-locked).
`Pubkey::default()` (unset) makes perp withdrawals inert.

fields.name: protocol_fee_recipient_spot
docs: Treasury that SPOT protocol fees (each market's own token: lending
carveouts + spot-liquidation cuts) may be withdrawn to. Settable only
by `cold_admin`. `withdraw_protocol_fees_spot` pays this key's
associated token account for the market's mint (recipient-locked).
`Pubkey::default()` (unset) makes spot withdrawals inert.

fields.name: hot_fee_withdraw
docs: Hot key authorized for the `FeeWithdraw` role (triggers protocol-fee
withdrawals to the configured recipients).

fields.name: hot_account_extension
docs: Hot key authorized for the `AccountExtension` role (grows zero-copy
accounts to the deployed program's size after a struct-extending
upgrade).

fields.name: promo_fee_tier
docs: Promotional fee-tier floor applied to every account: the effective
perp fee tier is `max(volume tier, promo_fee_tier)` (clamped to the
configured tier count), so nobody is downgraded by it. 0 = no-op
(disabled), also what pre-upgrade accounts read from former padding.
Reset to 0 and every account is back on its volume tier at its next
fill; no per-user state.

fields.name: slot_duration_ms
docs: Legacy current slot duration field in milliseconds, kept coherent by
the permissionless sync as the IBRL feature gates activate
(400 -> 350 -> 300 -> 250 -> 200). `0` means unset (what pre upgrade
accounts read out of former padding) and is interpreted as the 400ms
baseline. Never read this field directly, use [`State::slot_clock`] /
[`State::slot_duration`]; once any `slot_duration_transition_slots`
entry is set the archive is authoritative over this field.

fields.name: pending_slot_duration_ms
docs: Legacy staged next slot duration in ms, kept coherent by the
permissionless sync for older readers. `0` means nothing is staged. Once
`slot_duration_effective_slot` is reached, the legacy resolution returns
this value instead of `slot_duration_ms`. Superseded by the transition
archive.

fields.name: slot_duration_pad
docs: Explicit padding so `slot_duration_effective_slot` (u64) lands on its
8-byte alignment with no *implicit* padding (see the alignment invariant).

fields.name: slot_duration_effective_slot
docs: Slot at which `pending_slot_duration_ms` takes effect: the first slot of
the epoch after the target gate's activation epoch, derived from the
`EpochSchedule` sysvar at sync time. `0` when nothing is staged.

fields.name: slot_duration_transition_slots
docs: First slot of each post baseline IBRL regime, ordered as
`[350ms, 300ms, 250ms, 200ms]`. Zero means that transition has not been
synchronized yet. These anchors let elapsed time math integrate an
interval piecewise instead of multiplying its whole slot delta by the
duration at one endpoint.

fields.name: padding
docs: 200 = the former 244 byte padding minus the 12 staging bytes and the 32
bytes used by `slot_duration_transition_slots`.
(`pending_slot_duration_ms` 2 + `slot_duration_pad` 2 + the 8-byte
`slot_duration_effective_slot`). The padding still absorbs the 8 bytes that
were previously *implicit* trailing padding on x86_64 (State contains a
u128, align 16 on the host but 8 on SBF; explicit padding keeps
`size_of::<State>()` 1744 on both targets, per the alignment invariant in
docs/alignment-and-native-offsets.md).

fields.name: authority
docs: The owner/authority of the account

fields.name: delegate
docs: An addresses that can control the account on the authority's behalf. Has limited power, cant withdraw

fields.name: name
docs: Encoded display name e.g. "toly"

fields.name: spot_positions
docs: The user's spot positions

fields.name: perp_positions
docs: The user's perp positions

fields.name: orders
docs: The user's orders

fields.name: total_deposits
docs: The total values of deposits the user has made
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: total_withdraws
docs: The total values of withdrawals the user has made
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: total_social_loss
docs: The total socialized loss the users has incurred upon the protocol
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: settled_perp_pnl
docs: Fees (taker fees, maker rebate, referrer reward, filler reward) and pnl for perps
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: cumulative_spot_fees
docs: Fees (taker fees, maker rebate, filler reward) for spot
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: cumulative_perp_funding
docs: Cumulative funding paid/received for perps
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: liquidation_margin_freed
docs: The amount of margin freed during liquidation. Used to force the liquidation to occur over a period of time
Defaults to zero when not being liquidated
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: last_active_slot
docs: The last slot a user was active. Used to determine if a user is idle

fields.name: next_order_id
docs: Every user order has an order id. This is the next order id to be used

fields.name: max_margin_ratio
docs: Custom max initial margin ratio for the user

fields.name: next_liquidation_id
docs: The next liquidation id to be used for user

fields.name: sub_account_id
docs: The sub account id for this user

fields.name: status
docs: Whether the user is active, being liquidated or bankrupt

fields.name: is_margin_trading_enabled
docs: Whether the user has enabled margin trading

fields.name: idle
docs: User is idle if they haven't interacted with the protocol in 1 week and they have no orders, perp positions or borrows
Off-chain keeper bots can ignore users that are idle

fields.name: open_orders
docs: number of open orders

fields.name: has_open_order
docs: Whether or not user has open order

fields.name: open_auctions
docs: number of open orders with auction

fields.name: has_open_auction
docs: Whether or not user has open order with auction

fields.name: special_user_status
docs: Whether the user is a special user (vamm hedger, etc)

fields.name: equity_floor
docs: Minimum account net equity (unweighted assets plus perp pnl minus
spot liabilities, see `calculate_user_equity`). Below this the
permissionless breaker can trip. Risk-increasing orders, fills,
withdrawals and deposit transfers must clear `equity_floor +
equity_floor_buffer`. Settable only by the warm/cold admin; 0 disables
both checks.
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: equity_floor_buffer
docs: Extra headroom above `equity_floor` required by risk-increasing
actions, so an account cannot legally end an action at the trip
threshold. No effect while `equity_floor` is 0.
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: total_fee_paid
docs: Total taker fee paid
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: total_fee_rebate
docs: Total maker fee rebate
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: total_token_discount
docs: Total discount from holding token
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: total_referee_discount
docs: Total discount from being referred
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: authority
docs: The authority for all of a users sub accounts

fields.name: referrer
docs: The address that referred this user

fields.name: fees
docs: Stats on the fees paid by the user

fields.name: maker_volume_30d
docs: Rolling 30day maker volume for user
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: taker_volume_30d
docs: Rolling 30day taker volume for user
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: filler_volume_30d
docs: Rolling 30day filler volume for user
precision: QUOTE_PRECISION

fields.name: last_maker_volume_30d_ts
docs: last time the maker volume was updated

fields.name: last_taker_volume_30d_ts
docs: last time the taker volume was updated

fields.name: last_filler_volume_30d_ts
docs: last time the filler volume was updated

fields.name: if_staked_quote_asset_amount
docs: The amount of tokens staked in the quote spot markets if

fields.name: number_of_sub_accounts
docs: The current number of sub accounts

fields.name: number_of_sub_accounts_created
docs: The number of sub accounts created. Can be greater than the number of sub accounts if user
has deleted sub accounts

fields.name: referrer_status
docs: Flags for referrer status:
First bit (LSB): 1 if user is a referrer, 0 otherwise
Second bit: 1 if user was referred, 0 otherwise

fields.name: padding1
docs: 9 bytes: 1 byte of former repr(C) alignment padding + the removed
8-byte `if_staked_gov_token_amount` field (gov-token stake fee discount)

fields.name: delegate_permissions
docs: Delegate permissions across all sub accounts

fields.name: equity_breaker_tripped
docs: Set by the permissionless `trip_equity_floor_breaker` instruction when
any of the authority's subaccounts falls below its equity floor.
While set, every subaccount of the authority rejects risk-increasing
fills, withdrawals and transfers out. Cleared only by the warm admin.

fields.name: accelerated_referral_status
docs: Persistent referral reward status. See [`AcceleratedReferralStatus`]. Kept
separate from `referrer_status`, which describes whether this authority
refers or was referred by somebody else. Carved out of former padding so
preupgrade accounts read `0` (standard, automatic enrollment allowed).

fields.name: slots_before_stale_for_amm
docs: Compact wall-clock duration encoded in historical 400ms slot quanta.

fields.name: slots_before_stale_for_margin
docs: Compact wall-clock duration encoded in historical 400ms slot quanta.
